question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**just**" means exactly or precisely at a moment in time.
 
• In the context of the sentence, **"as if he had just__ awakened from a deep dream" **means that the person had very recently woken up.
 
• The other options: "**so**", "**after**", and "**therefore**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** He instantly jumped up, and it was not the same man, but another man! And there he was, looking bewildered and disoriented, as if he had __just__ awakened from a deep dream.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **So (तो)**: means for this reason; therefore.
 
• **After (के बाद)**: means in the time following an event.
 
• **Therefore (इसलिए)**: means as a result or for that reason.
